Yeah. This one's for the places they fly over

[Verse 1: male rap, proud and unhurried]
I'm from where the Friday lights are bigger than the mall
Where the diner knows your order and your mama's on the wall
Where the mayor coaches Little League and drives the plough in snow
And the weatherman's your cousin, so you already know
Got a main street with a hardware store that's older than the state
Got a church on every corner and a bar across the way
Kid, I learned to drive a stick shift in a field behind the gym
Learned to lose with my head up, learned to tip my hat to him
They said "you'll never make it out," I said "who's trying to leave?"
Everything I ever needed's in the roll of this sleeve

[Chorus: female soul voice, soaring, strings]
Oh, my town
Water tower wearing our name like a crown
One stoplight and a thousand ways to shine
My town
Where the whole wide world's a little farther down
Sing it loud for the small and proud
My town, my town, my town

[Verse 2: male rap, warmer, piano keeps hammering]
Caught a flight to the coast and the buildings scraped the sky
Twenty-dollar sandwich and nobody said hi
Did a year, did another, made a name and made a dime
But I kept my watch on Central and my heart on county time
'Cause the corn don't care who's famous and the river don't keep score
And the lady at the post office has known me since I was four
So I'm back with a truck bed full of everything I own
You can take the kid from nowhere, but he still calls nowhere home
Parade's on the Fourth, bring a chair and bring a friend
I'll be the one behind the fire truck, waving at the bend

[Chorus: female soul voice, soaring, strings]
Oh, my town
Water tower wearing our name like a crown
One stoplight and a thousand ways to shine
My town
Where the whole wide world's a little farther down
Sing it loud for the small and proud
My town, my town, my town

[Bridge: female voice alone with piano, then building]
One hand on the wheel
One hand in the air
For every town too small for the map
We're still there
We're still there

[Final Chorus: both voices, choir, rap ad-libs between lines]
Oh, my town
Water tower wearing our name like a crown
One stoplight and a thousand ways to shine
My town
Where the whole wide world's a little farther down
Sing it loud for the small and proud
My town, my town, my town

[Outro: piano chords, a distant train horn]
